- Fixed: the music player's media card (the phone's media notification) no longer appears out of nowhere when nothing is playing. A widget, tile or the Bluetooth check that loads the last queue (paused) used to pop it up; the card now shows only after something was really played.
- Fixed: a headset plugged in at zero volume no longer starts the old song later, on any volume press. The wait ends after a minute, and the song never starts over another player (YTXTube, a video, a call).
- YTXTube picture-in-picture: its Next button only moves among videos and never opens a song of the music queue.
- Files home: the "Received files" shortcut is gone (Pulse/Share is still a folder in the list).
- Convert: PowerPoint (.pptx) can be converted to PDF (one page per slide, real text and pictures), and spreadsheets (.xlsx) to PDF too. Convert files is also in Office tools, next to Scan document and PDF tools; the tools are two to a row with an icon, a name and a description, and the choices of the converter (PNG, JPG, PDF, M4A …) are tiles with an icon and a description instead of bare chips.
- YTXTube picture-in-picture: the headphones button plays the sound on in the background and no longer leaves audio-only on: back in the app the video shows and plays again (audio-only that was on before stays on).
- No more badges on the app icons for ongoing notifications (weather, YTXTube and video playback cards, Galaxy Buds): their channels are made without a badge. Pulse has many launcher icons and each wore the dot. Their notification channels were re-created, so a setting changed for them in the phone's notification settings starts from the default.
